no18.summary: Latin articles negotiated by Sienese orators with Maximilian I's side, subscribed by his secretary Niklas Ziegler, dated by George Lasry to Pisa, October-November 1496: Siena to ready artillery and lend the King 5,000 ducats repayable in two months, open war near Ponte a Valiano against the Florentines with passage, victuals, 100 men-at-arms and 60 light horse, and have its claims against Florence judged by the Emperor.

F. The imperial chancery cipher of 1496
• No. 18 = R4806

— Maximilian I and the Sienese orators, Pisa, November 1496 (Latin), 1,469 symbols —
solved ciphertext-only by Lasry with CTTS and Claude (15–17 October 2026)

No. 18 (R4806): League articles of Maximilian I and the Sienese orators,
Pisa, Oct–Nov 1496
Status. Solved: all cipher passages read; parties and date identified. 15–17 October 2026, by George Lasry
with CTTS and Claude: transcription by Claude, refined by the author in CTTS;

snip.credit: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 18 p. 1, via DECODE R4806

system: Per George Lasry's key: 60 distinct signs. Homophonic substitution with double-letter signs (rr, pp, ss, ll, cc, tt), dotted or barred signs as nulls and a few code capitals (B = the League, X = the enemy, M.X.). The project's transcription named 30 signs…
